prompt: It is very common for people to change both their habits and their opinions as they get older. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. write band 7 essay
essay:
It is very common for people to change their habits and opinions as they grow older. I strongly agree with this view because people's priorities, responsibilities and life experiences change over time. As a result, they often develop different lifestyles and perspectives.

One major reason why people's habits change is that their responsibilities increase with age. When people are young, they usually have more free time to participate in hobbies and social activities. However, as they become adults, they often have to manage their careers, family responsibilities and household commitments. Consequently, they may have less time for activities they enjoyed in childhood. For example, a person who regularly played sports as a teenager may stop playing frequently after starting a full-time job because of a busy schedule. This does not necessarily mean that they have completely lost interest; rather, their priorities have changed.

People's opinions also tend to change because they gain knowledge and experience throughout their lives. Young people may form opinions based on limited information or the influence of their family and friends. As they encounter different situations, meet people from diverse backgrounds and learn from their mistakes, their perspectives can become more balanced. For instance, someone who once believed that changing jobs frequently was the best way to achieve success might later realise the value of job stability and long-term career development after gaining professional experience.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that people commonly change their habits and opinions as they grow older. Increasing responsibilities can influence their daily routines, while greater knowledge and life experience can lead them to reconsider their views. Therefore, these changes are a natural part of personal development.
